result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but the restaurant metadata beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is visibly overlapping and unreadable.

issues.description: The delivery time and delivery-fee text below “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” overlap each other, creating a garbled string around “25–30 min” and the delivery fee.
issues.suggestion: Place each metadata item in a properly spaced horizontal row using non-overlapping flex items, separators, and responsive wrapping when space is limited.
